name: Bloom Energy
constraint_controlled: On-site power generation that bypasses grid connection queues
physics_thesis: Solid-oxide fuel cells convert natural gas to DC electricity on-site - bypassing the 5-7 year grid interconnection queue. Aschenbrenner's largest position ($855M). Backlog exceeds $20B; revenue growing ~34% in 2025 ~40% guided for 2026.
key_metrics: Revenue growth;Backlog size ($20B+);Electrolyzer optionality

name: Vistra Energy
constraint_controlled: Existing permitted power generation capacity - takes decades to replicate
physics_thesis: Largest competitive power generator in the US. Nuclear + gas fleet provides 24/7 firm power that hyperscalers desperately need. Has direct corporate PPA pipeline with data centre tenants.
key_metrics: Installed capacity (GW);Data centre PPA pipeline;Nuclear fleet longevity

name: Constellation Energy
constraint_controlled: US nuclear generation fleet - irreplaceable; 10+ years to add meaningfully
physics_thesis: Largest US nuclear fleet. Microsoft signed a 20-year PPA. Nuclear provides the only scalable 24/7 zero-carbon power - uniquely suited for AI data centre ESG mandates.
key_metrics: Nuclear capacity (GW);Corporate PPA pipeline;Carbon-free premium pricing

name: NRG Energy
constraint_controlled: Permitted gas generation capacity + retail customer relationships
physics_thesis: Diversified gas + renewables fleet with retail energy arm. Growing large commercial and industrial customer base including data centre loads.
key_metrics: Data centre revenue mix;New capacity additions;Retail margin

name: Core Scientific
constraint_controlled: Pre-connected power sites + permitting that took years to secure
physics_thesis: Bitcoin miners own pre-permitted pre-connected power infrastructure. CORZ is converting sites to host Nvidia GPUs under a CoreWeave contract. Building new data centre power from scratch takes 5-7 years; CORZ has it now.
key_metrics: HPC hosting MW contracted;Power cost (cents per kWh);CoreWeave contract value

name: TeraWulf
constraint_controlled: Nuclear-adjacent pre-connected power at industry-lowest cost
physics_thesis: Nuclear-powered Bitcoin miner (Nautilus facility co-located at Susquehanna nuclear plant). Sub-$0.02/kWh power cost + zero-carbon is the ideal foundation for AI compute. Converting capacity to HPC hosting.
key_metrics: Power cost advantage vs peers;Nuclear partnership;HPC capacity (MW)

name: Iris Energy
constraint_controlled: Cheap hydro-powered pre-connected data centre sites
physics_thesis: Canadian hydro-powered miner already running NVIDIA H100s for AI inference revenue. Cheap hydroelectric power + existing permitting = natural AI data centre footprint.
key_metrics: GPU cloud revenue growth;Hydro power cost;AI capacity (MW)

name: Applied Digital
constraint_controlled: High-density AI compute hosting in power-rich low-cost regions
physics_thesis: Pivoted fully from crypto to HPC hosting. Builds high-density AI data centres in power-rich markets (North Dakota). Long-term HPC contracts with AI companies.
key_metrics: HPC hosting revenue;Contracted MW;Power cost per kWh

name: Riot Platforms
constraint_controlled: Pre-connected Texas power + ERCOT curtailment optionality
physics_thesis: One of the largest Bitcoin miners; ~1 GW of pre-connected power in Texas. ERCOT power curtailment credits create unique cash flow. Infrastructure optionable for AI conversion.
key_metrics: Installed power (MW);Curtailment revenue;AI conversion timeline

name: Marathon Digital
constraint_controlled: Global diversified power infrastructure + permitting pipeline
physics_thesis: Largest publicly traded Bitcoin miner by hashrate. Diversified global power infrastructure. Optionality to repurpose sites for AI is the physics arbitrage thesis.
key_metrics: Hashrate (EH/s);Installed power (GW);AI optionality progress

name: Eaton Corporation
constraint_controlled: Electrical distribution equipment - physically can't build data centres without it
physics_thesis: Makes power management systems transformers switchgear and UPS systems. Every data centre EV charger and renewable connection requires Eaton equipment. 2-3 year order backlog.
key_metrics: Order backlog;Data centre segment revenue %;Pricing power

name: GE Vernova
constraint_controlled: Gas turbine production capacity + grid automation - 3+ year delivery times
physics_thesis: Makes gas turbines wind turbines and grid automation. Only company supplying both fast-ramp gas peakers (needed for AI firm power) and the grid automation equipment for smart interconnection. Multi-year order backlog.
key_metrics: Turbine backlog ($B);Grid segment orders;Electrification revenue

name: Quanta Services
constraint_controlled: Skilled electrical labour and project management - the scarcest resource in grid buildout
physics_thesis: Largest electrical contractor in North America. Builds and maintains power transmission and distribution. Every new data centre and generation project requires Quanta to physically connect it to the grid.
key_metrics: Backlog ($24B+);Renewable + data centre mix %;Revenue per employee

name: Hubbell
constraint_controlled: Distribution transformers and wiring components - unavoidable physical requirement
physics_thesis: Makes distribution transformers wiring devices and grid hardening products. Every electrical installation - data centres grid upgrades EV infrastructure - requires Hubbell components.
key_metrics: Utility segment growth;Distribution transformer backlog;Price and mix lift

name: Vertiv Holdings
constraint_controlled: Liquid cooling and power management for AI data centres - no physical alternative
physics_thesis: H100/GB200 chips dissipate 700-1200W each - physics makes air cooling impossible beyond 50kW per rack. Vertiv makes the liquid cooling and UPS systems that are physically mandatory for AI clusters. Order backlog exceeds 2 years.
key_metrics: AI data centre order mix;Liquid cooling revenue;Backlog ($B)

name: Modine Manufacturing
constraint_controlled: Thermal management for high-density AI compute racks
physics_thesis: Precision thermal management for data centres. AI chip thermal density forces adoption of advanced cooling solutions. Data centre segment is now Modine's fastest-growing business line.
key_metrics: Data centre segment revenue %;Thermal product margins;Order growth

name: Cameco
constraint_controlled: Uranium mine supply - geologically scarce with decade-long production lead times
physics_thesis: Largest publicly traded uranium miner. Nuclear renaissance - driven by AI power demand + decarbonisation - requires more uranium. Supply is structurally limited: mines take 10+ years to bring online and Kazakhstan controls 45% of world supply.
key_metrics: Uranium price ($/lb U3O8);Production volume (Mlb);Long-term contract %

name: Oklo Inc.
constraint_controlled: First-mover position in commercial microreactor licensing pipeline
physics_thesis: Factory-built microreactors (1.5-15 MW) deployable directly at data centres bypassing the grid entirely - the ultimate physics arbitrage. Sam Altman-backed; NRC licensing in progress.
key_metrics: NRC licensing milestones;LOI pipeline (MW);Revenue timeline

name: Freeport-McMoRan
constraint_controlled: Copper mine production - geologically constrained with decade-long supply lead times
physics_thesis: Copper is how electricity physically moves. Every data centre EV and renewable installation needs copper. AI data centres use 4-5x more copper per MW. Mine supply takes 10-20 years to develop; grade is declining globally.
key_metrics: Copper production (kt);AISC ($/lb);Reserve grade trend

name: Southern Copper
constraint_controlled: World's largest copper reserves - irreplaceable geographic asset
physics_thesis: World's largest copper reserve base. Low-cost producer in Peru and Mexico. Structural demand from electrification + AI makes this a multi-decade story.
key_metrics: Copper reserves (billion tonnes);AISC ($/lb);Production growth (kt/yr)
